clips.title: The story
paras: In Darkshire, Clerk Daltry matches the recovered handwriting to Stalvan Mistmantle. His report to Commander Althea Ebonlocke turns the Night Watch's suspicion into fact.

Back in Darkshire's town hall, Clerk Daltry compares the bloodstained journal page with signatures in the Town Registry. The handwriting is an exact match for Stalvan Mistmantle. After a trail through manors, inns, and civic records across the human kingdoms, the Night Watch now has the evidence to treat the danger as an urgent local threat.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Let Commander Ebonlocke know immediately that the handwriting matched, friend! Her suspicions were correct!

clips.title: Completion
paras: I knew it! Fine work, friend.
